events.name: Lucky Streak Chain
events.intro: A little stall chalks up a streak board: three wins in a row and you pick any prize. The first game is a coin toss.

success.text: Heads! One win on the board.

failure.text: Tails. The board is wiped clean, but the keeper tosses you a consolation berry.

success.text: Tails! One win on the board.

failure.text: Heads. The board is wiped clean, but the keeper tosses you a consolation berry.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Lucky Streak Chain: Two
events.intro: Second game: pick a cup. One of three hides the marble.

success.text: The marble! Two wins in a row.

failure.text: Empty. The streak ends here.

success.text: The marble! Two wins in a row.

failure.text: Empty. The streak ends here.

success.text: The keeper pays out the two-win bonus.

events.name: Lucky Streak Chain: Three
events.intro: Last game: a die roll. Beat a four to claim the prize shelf!

success.text: A six! The whole shelf is yours to pick from.

failure.text: A one. So close. You still get a prize from the lower shelf.

success.text: The keeper pays out a streak bonus.

events.name: The Curse Lottery
events.intro: A hooded clerk spins a drum of tickets. "Every curse comes with its blessing. You only get to pick the ticket."

success.text: The ticket reads: Heavy Hands. Hits land harder on you, but you learn faster.

failure.text: The ticket reads: Thin Purse. Prices bite, but your wins pay more.

success.text: Both tickets burn up. Their blessing stays: something kinder watches over the team.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Pact Booth
events.intro: A clerk in a red coat pushes a contract across the counter. "Harder fights, richer pay. Sign here. Initial there."

choices.label: Sign the Lesser Pact (foes +2 levels, money +40%)

success.text: The ink dries. The road ahead feels meaner, and so does your wallet.

choices.label: Sign the Greater Pact (foes +4 levels, money +80%, XP +20%)

success.text: The clerk smiles for the first time.
You fold the contract and hand it back.

events.name: The Rule Board
events.intro: A notice board lists house rules for the rest of the run. Pin up one of them and it counts for you, too.

success.text: You tack the rule up. Your pockets feel heavier already.
Fainted is fainted. The lessons stick.
Rich and in danger.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Lucky Number
events.intro: A fortune stand asks you to pick a number from one to three. "Hit the right one and the road rewards you, all run long."

success.text: One it is! Luck follows you from here.

failure.text: Not your number. Here is a small prize for playing.

success.text: Two it is! Luck follows you from here.

failure.text: Not your number. Here is a small prize for playing.

success.text: Three it is! Luck follows you from here.

failure.text: Not your number. Here is a small prize for playing.

events.name: The Risk Dial
events.intro: A brass dial on a post, marked from Calm to Chaos. Whatever you set it to, a challenger turns up to match it.

success.text: A trainer strolls up, easy as you like.
The dial clicks. A tougher trainer steps out.
Bells ring. An ace trainer tears down the road at you.

events.name: Fate Cards
events.intro: A dealer fans three cards face down. "Each one gives, and each one takes. Pick one."

choices.label: The Sun: heal everyone, lose some gold

success.text: Warm light. The team is fresh, the purse is lighter.

choices.label: The Tower: a rare find, a rough fall

success.text: Rubble and treasure. The lead takes a knock, but you find something good.

choices.label: The Star: a new friend, a stranger's debt

success.text: Someone follows you from the table. The dealer takes a cut.

events.name: Mood Swing
events.intro: A strange breeze rolls over the team. Everyone's mood tips, for better or worse.

success.text: Laughing fits all round. The team bonds.

failure.text: Sulking all round. A few of them need cheering up.

success.text: Snacks fix every mood.
You wait it out in the shade.

events.name: The Shadow Boon
events.intro: Your own shadow offers a loan. "I will lend you strength now. You pay it back later."

choices.label: Borrow health: heal everyone, take more damage later

success.text: The wounds close. Somewhere ahead, a bill is waiting.

choices.label: Borrow strength: hit harder, heal less

success.text: Your team feels stronger than it ought to.
Your shadow shrugs and falls in behind you.

events.name: The Echo Item
events.intro: A small echo-stone repeats whatever you hold up to it. "Show me something from your bag."

success.text: A second Potion drops out.
A second Revive rolls out.
A second Rare Candy clinks down.
The echo repeats "nothing" a few times and goes quiet.

events.name: The Crowd Poll
events.intro: A crowd is gathered around a stream camera. "Chat votes! Whatever wins helps your next few fights."

success.text: "Hearth!" the crowd roars. A warm shield settles around the team.

failure.text: "Bloom!" the crowd chants. The team heals after fights for a while.

success.text: The crowd cheers for the wild ones.
A clear head for the next fights.

events.name: The Chaos Dial
events.intro: Three doors with no labels. A sign: "All choices here are random. Probably."

success.text: A shower of gold coins!

failure.text: A bucket of cold water. Everyone is fine, just damp.

success.text: A big sack of items tips out.

failure.text: Nothing but dust and a rude note.

success.text: A cheering crowd lifts the lead a level!

failure.text: A friendly Pokémon pulls a prank on you.

events.name: A Nobody With a Secret
events.intro: A quiet person on the roadside waves you over. "You look like you can keep a secret. I need something found."

success.text: "Remember me when you pass a stranger's grave, a lake and a lantern. I will find you again."

effects.text: Took a secret quest from a nobody.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Nobody Returns
events.intro: The quiet person from the roadside is waiting at the next crossing, grinning. "You kept your eyes open. Here is what I promised."

success.text: The nobody turns out to be a collector of rare things. They give you one.

events.name: The Sealed Letter
events.intro: A courier presses a sealed letter into your hand. "Do not open it yet. Wait until the road gets hard."

success.text: You tuck the letter away and feel strangely lucky.
The letter holds a coupon for a small gift.

events.name: The Letter, Opened
events.intro: The road has gotten hard. You break the wax seal at last. Inside, a note: "I knew you would need this. Behind the old signpost."

success.text: A chest of gifts, exactly as promised.

events.name: The Reversing Mirror
events.intro: A tall mirror shows the last thing that happened to you, back to front. Step through and it flips your fortunes the same way.

success.text: Your reflection hands you a purse and takes a bruise.
Your reflection takes the coins and hands you a clean bill of health.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A Perfect Rest Day
events.intro: A meadow with nothing in it but soft grass and a warm sun. Nothing is scheduled, and no one will find you.

success.text: Everyone naps, eats and plays. A new day dawns.
A short breather.

events.name: It's Your Birthday!
events.intro: Everyone you have met lines the road with streamers. Somebody wheels out a cake. "Happy birthday, trainer!"

success.text: Make a wish. The gifts pile up.

choices.label: Share the cake with the team

success.text: The cake is gone in seconds, and so are the worries.

events.name: The Seasonal Visitor
events.intro: A traveller in clothes for the weather hands out presents. "It's that time of year again!"

success.text: A neat pastel egg.
Ice-cold drinks for everyone.
The harvest is in.
Scarf, stone, and a hot meal.

events.name: The Free Pick Altar
events.intro: Three relics glow on a stone altar. "Take one. The others will vanish."

success.text: Warmth in your fists. The other two relics fade.

choices.label: The Blue Relic: heal after fights

success.text: A cool calm settles over the team. The other two relics fade.
The weight of wealth. The other two relics fade.

events.name: The Altar of Swaps
events.intro: A stone altar hums. "Leave one of yours. Take one of mine. We keep it fair."

choices.label: Swap your weakest for a stranger

success.text: The altar takes one and gives you another of its own.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Draft Pool
events.intro: Five Pokémon wait behind a rope, all looking for a trainer. You can take just one.

success.text: It tumbles into the party.
It stares you down, then joins.
It follows you quietly.
It nods once. A good sign.

events.name: The Reroll Shrine
events.intro: A small stone shrine with three coin slots. "Toss in a coin and the road ahead is dealt again."

success.text: The road ahead rearranges itself. A new door opens beside you.
The road ahead is wholly new. Also, you can see where the hidden stops are.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Skip Token Stand
events.intro: A kid sells paper passes. "Skip the next node! Rides you right on past."

success.text: The kid punches your pass and waves you through.
The kid sighs and gives you a discount.

failure.text: The kid does not budge, and you do not buy.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Redo Ticket Booth
events.intro: A bored clerk sells pink tickets. "Lose a fight? Show this at the door and fight it again."

success.text: You tuck the ticket away. The next time a Pokémon falls, it just might get back up.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Probability Mage
events.intro: A mage looks at you with half-closed eyes. "I will tell you what the dice want. I will not change them."

choices.label: See what waits in the wild

success.text: Green fog clears. Wild Pokémon show up on your map.
Shapes of the trainers ahead sharpen.
The Gym Leader's team stands in a line before you.

events.name: The Team Banner Station
events.intro: A seamstress hangs team banners from a line. "Pick a banner. It carries a little luck with it."

success.text: It snaps proudly in the wind.
It smells of rain and clean cloth.
It glints like coin.
The team seems closer already.

events.name: The Anniversary Archive
events.intro: A hidden archive opens only for runs that have come this far. Shelves of photos and trinkets from all your journeys.

success.text: A line about you is written on every page. You feel seen.
A little souvenir to carry on.

choices.label: Leave a note for next time

success.text: You pin a note to the wall. The archive hums.

events.name: The Lucky Coin Vault
events.intro: A round vault door with a coin slot. "What goes in turns into research that outlasts your run."

success.text: The coins clink away. A voucher pops out.
A big clunk. The vault rewards you well.
The vault door glows gold.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Legacy Pedestal
events.intro: A stone pedestal waits with room for one item. The runs before you left things here, and so can you.

choices.label: Recover a keepsake from an earlier run

success.text: You lift a keepsake off the pedestal.

choices.label: Leave a Rare Candy as a gift to the future

success.text: The pedestal accepts it. Your name is carved beneath.

choices.label: Leave a Nugget as a gift to the future

success.text: The pedestal accepts it.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Hall of Records
events.intro: Glass cases line the walls: your best runs, wins and wild moments. A plaque offers a challenge.

success.text: You pick up a few tips from your past runs.

choices.label: Take the plaque's challenge: no healing stops

success.text: You accept. The plaque glows.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Memory Lane
events.intro: A path of lanterns, each holding a scene from a long way back. Nothing here changes, but it is lovely to see.

success.text: You watch the old days pass in light. The team hums along.
A single warm scene. A little bit of peace.

effects.text: Picked a lantern on Memory Lane.

events.name: The Pocket Dimension Closet
events.intro: A wardrobe that is bigger on the inside. "Store anything. Come back for it later and I will keep it safe."

success.text: The door shuts. You mark the spot on your map.
The door shuts. You mark the spot on your map.
The door shuts. You mark the spot on your map.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Closet, Again
events.intro: The same wardrobe stands at this crossroad. It opens with a creak, and the Rare Candy inside seems to have grown.

success.text: Two Rare Candies where there was one.

events.name: The Closet, Again
events.intro: The same wardrobe stands at this crossroad. It opens with a creak.

success.text: Three Max Potions where there was one.

events.name: The Closet, Again
events.intro: The same wardrobe stands at this crossroad. It opens with a creak.

success.text: Two Revives where there was one.

events.name: The Bounty Hunter
events.intro: A hard-eyed hunter leans out of a doorway. "I hunt the strongest one in any team. Sign my contract and I fight you for the pay."

success.text: "Good. Let's see how strong your best really is."
They tip their hat and walk away.
You duck down an alley. They don't follow.

failure.text: They were faster than they looked.

events.name: The Third Wheel
events.intro: A mystery NPC in a long coat falls in step with you, saying nothing. They seem to be waiting for something.

success.text: They hum, whistle, and chat with the Pokémon. After a few nodes, they'll pay you back.
They tip a hat and take a different road.

events.name: The Crossroads of Four
events.intro: Four doors: wood, iron, silver, gold. A sign says each leads to a richer, riskier event than the last.

success.text: Creak. A common sort of scene is behind it.
Clang. Something uncommon waits.
A hush. Something rare waits.
Light spills out. Something epic waits.

events.name: Behind the Wood Door
events.intro: A snug pantry stocked for a long trip.

success.text: Plenty to go around.

events.name: Behind the Iron Door
events.intro: A sparring hall with one lone fighter in the middle.

success.text: The fighter bows and begins.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Behind the Silver Door
events.intro: A glittering gallery with a single glass case.

success.text: Inside is a silver star and a card of thanks.

events.name: Behind the Gold Door
events.intro: A throne room with a throne no one sits on, and a crown on a cushion.

success.text: Gold pours out. The throne gives a gift to anyone brave enough to enter.

events.name: The Sunk Cost Choice
events.intro: A half-built wooden bridge across a gorge. A builder shrugs. "We're in too deep. Keep paying, or take a refund and go around."

success.text: The bridge is done! A fine toll and a fine view.

failure.text: The bridge collapses. The builder is very sorry.

choices.label: Take the refund and go around

success.text: The builder pays up, a little guilty.

events.name: A Perfect Day
events.intro: The sun is warm, the breeze is soft, and everyone on this road is smiling at you. Nothing here can go wrong.

success.text: Warm light on every back.
The crowd tosses you gifts.
A talented dancer gives the lead a hand. It comes away stronger.

events.name: A Terrible Day
events.intro: Dark clouds, a flat tire on a cart, and a stuck bag. Nothing here can go right. But storms leave more behind than they take.

success.text: Everything goes wrong. When the clouds clear, there is a heap of lost goods in the mud.
You wait it out in a cave. A little bit of treasure.

events.name: Twin Nodes
events.intro: Two scenes unfold side by side at the same crossroad. You can walk through one, or squeeze through both at a price.

success.text: You step left.
You step right.
You hurry through each in turn.

events.name: Twin Nodes: Left
events.intro: A tidy camp. A cook waves.

success.text: A hearty meal for everyone.

events.name: Twin Nodes: Right
events.intro: A dusty market stall. A trader waves.

success.text: A few handy things.

events.name: Counting Sheep
events.intro: A grassy hill. Nothing is happening. Nothing at all. A sleepy Pokémon counts something under its breath.

success.text: One. Two. Three. You nod off. Something stirs in the back of your mind, a counter that doesn't stop.
You sleep soundly.

events.name: The Reverse Wishing Fountain
events.intro: The fountain is full of coins and a sign: "Take a coin instead of leaving one." What could go wrong?

success.text: A shiny coin. You feel luckier. Slightly.

failure.text: A cold current pulls the coin from your hand. A tiny curse follows.

success.text: A fistful of coins, and a fountain spirit rolls its eyes at you.

failure.text: The fountain spits you out. Everyone is soaked, and the coins are gone.

success.text: You toss a coin and make a wish.

events.name: The Interview
events.intro: A hiring manager with a clipboard. "What are you best at? Be honest. Your answer decides how you travel from here on."

success.text: Written down: Bold. You lean into it.
Written down: Careful. You lean into it.
Written down: Shrewd. You lean into it.
Written down: Lucky. You lean into it.

events.name: The Pokémon Census
events.intro: A clerk with a clipboard counts the Pokémon on the road. "Report your team and get paid by how varied it is."

success.text: "Two, at least. Here is a little."
"A fine variety!" The clerk is delighted.

choices.label: Report a full team of six

success.text: "The best census I have ever seen!" You get the top bonus.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Challenge of the Day
events.intro: A board in the square posts today's puzzle. Solve it and the town hands out the prize.

success.text: Perfect! The prize hatch pops open.

failure.text: You miss the rhythm. The town pays you a pity prize.

success.text: Click! Today's record is yours.

failure.text: The tiles jam. Maybe tomorrow.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Elevator Floors
events.intro: A glass elevator with four buttons. Each floor is a different scene. The doors ding.

success.text: Doors open on a cozy lobby.
Doors open on flashing lights.
Doors open on clean white tile.
Doors open on open sky.

events.name: Elevator: The Lobby
events.intro: A tidy lobby with a free snack table.

success.text: Delicious.

events.name: Elevator: The Arcade
events.intro: A tiny arcade full of lights.

success.text: Top score!

failure.text: Game over. A few coins lighter.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Elevator: The Clinic
events.intro: A tiny clinic. The nurse smiles.

success.text: Everyone is healed.

events.name: Elevator: The Roof
events.intro: A rooftop with a great view of the road ahead.

success.text: You see far.

events.name: Treasure vs Trap
events.intro: Two chests in a dim cellar. A hooded NPC leans on the wall. "One is a treasure. One is a trap. I could give you a hint…"

choices.label: Ask the NPC for a hint (Intelligence)

success.text: The NPC points. Inside: a fine treasure!

failure.text: The NPC was lying. It was the trap.

success.text: A treasure!

failure.text: A trap! Gas, darts, bad language.

success.text: A treasure!

failure.text: A trap! Gas, darts, bad language.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Stranger's Dice
events.intro: A stranger shakes a pair of old bone dice. "Roll them and I'll tell you what the shops will charge from now on."

success.text: Snake eyes? No, double sixes! Shops owe you a discount.

failure.text: Bad roll. Shopkeepers will remember it.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Shifting Map
events.intro: The map in your hand curls at the corners. Ahead, the stops slide around like pieces on a board.

success.text: The next few nodes swap places. Keep your eyes open.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Mastery Echo
events.intro: A dojo gong rings with a deep, long echo. "Your next battle will teach double."

success.text: The echo settles into the team. Their next battle is a hard lesson, well learned.
You catch just a few words of the echo.

events.name: The Final Curtain
events.intro: A small theatre is putting on a play about a certain Gym Leader. The actor in the leader's cape gets every detail right.

success.text: Every move is on stage. You come away knowing the team.

choices.label: Sit up front and take notes

success.text: You see more than most, and even catch a few weak points.
You leave it be and walk on.
